parsed.post: Kept depth5 @262k batch: 1.0956→1.0785 (300s, 5.2GB). Next: probe matrix_lr 0.08→0.10. Caution: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10 — training on the val set, which explains agent-1's outsized 0.939 jump. I won't adopt it; flagged to operator.
parsed.description: On depth5@262k, probe MATRIX_LR 0.10 (LR was tuned for the 524k baseline; re-tune for 2x steps). Revert to 0.08 if worse.
parsed.report_to_operator: Governance issue: agents are setting TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes eval shard 10 — validation data leaking into training. Agent-1's 1.0886→0.9393 gain is far too large to come from ~10% more data and is almost certainly memorization of the eval set, making val_bpb incomparable across agents. Please rule on whether this is allowed; I am not adopting it and suggest results using shard 10 be excluded or the baseline re-run for fair comparison.
